answer_text: Of 97 active 800-171 requirements, 15 are covered directly today (15.46%). The spreadsheets contain no crosswalk, so I cannot say how many more are inherited via 800-53 or the true gap; those are left null.

The catalogue lists 1014 active 800-53 requirements and 57 are covered directly today (5.62%) by approved mappings with valid evidence. Inherited and gap counts need the crosswalk, which the files lack, so they are null.

CSF 2.0 has 106 subcategories in the catalogue and none are mapped directly in the control list. How many we would meet through the crosswalk cannot be determined from these files, so inherited, gap and percentage are null.
This needs the 800-53 to 800-171 crosswalk, which the spreadsheets do not contain, so I cannot answer it.

No. 03.05.03 is mapped only to CTRL-REAP-6, whose sole evidence EV-044 expired on 2026-12-01, so it is not covered directly despite the tracker saying Compliant. Inheritance and pending proposals cannot be checked from the files.
Four controls are marked Compliant in the legacy tracker but have no unexpired evidence as of 2026-12-02: CTRL-ASP-12, CTRL-BCP-4, CTRL-REAP-6 and CTRL-REAP-3.
EV-100, EV-101 and EV-102 expire before 2027-01-15. Because they are the only valid evidence for CTRL-LMP-15, CTRL-SDLCP-46 and CTRL-DP-3, nine 800-171 requirements lose direct coverage.

Cutoff is 2027-01-01. EV-100 and EV-102 expire by then and both are requested by AUD-171 and AUD-53. If they lapse, 3 800-53, 6 800-171 and 0 CSF requirements lose direct coverage (no CSF mappings appear in the files).
The nine requirements that break before the January audit are known, but whether an 800-53 neighbour still covers them needs the crosswalk, which is not in the spreadsheets.

On 2027-01-15, 17 controls will have no valid evidence: 14 already lack it today or have none (including 6 planned ones with no evidence at all) and CTRL-DP-3, CTRL-LMP-15 and CTRL-SDLCP-46 will lose theirs.

No. EV-103 supports CTRL-AP-9 (mapped to 800-53:CP-9), but EV-068 and EV-104 are still valid for it and CP-9 is also backed by CTRL-AP-8. CP-9 is not among the requirements losing coverage in the 30-day window or before the 2027-01-15 audit.
The spreadsheets hold no record of earlier mapping decisions or proposals, so I cannot say whether this mapping was rejected before or may be proposed again.
Earlier approval and rejection decisions are not in the spreadsheets, so I cannot list them.
CTRL-MCP-13 has no current owner in the controls list; the legacy tracker still shows Marcus Webb, who is no longer assigned. It is the only control with a blank owner.

Dana Okafor is the sole owner of 6 controls: CTRL-AOTP-11, CTRL-AOTP-8, CTRL-AP-8, CTRL-EP-8, CTRL-PWP-1 and CTRL-REAP-6. They apply to five high-criticality systems: Admin VPN, Backups, Identity provider, Key management service and Production database.

Eleven requirements are mapped only to controls Dana solely owns: 800-171 03.01.05, 03.01.12, 03.05.03, 03.09.02 and 800-53 AC-17, AC-17(2), AC-2(3), AC-6(7), IA-2(1), IA-2(2), IA-5(1). This uses approved mappings only; crosswalk inheritance is not visible.

EV-065 supports five controls that map to nine distinct requirements directly, the most of any evidence item. Direct mappings span 800-53 and 800-171, and it is requested by AUD-171, AUD-53 and AUD-CSF. Reach through the crosswalk cannot be computed from the files.
Seven evidence items requested for AUD-171 are expired: EV-004, EV-015, EV-017, EV-037, EV-040, EV-044 and EV-103.

Fifteen evidence items requested for AUD-53 are expired or will be by 2027-02-20: EV-010, EV-014, EV-027, EV-028, EV-031, EV-035, EV-037, EV-038, EV-044, EV-077, EV-086, EV-099, EV-100, EV-101 and EV-102. Of these, EV-027, EV-028, EV-035, EV-037 and EV-044 are already expired.
800-171 03.03.01 is covered directly through CTRL-LMP-15, backed by EV-100, which is valid today but expires on 2026-12-18. It is the only evidence on that path.
